bill.title: An Act amending the act of March 10, 1949 (P.L.30, No.14), known as the Public School Code of 1949, in school safety and security, providing for prohibition of artificial intelligence for school-based mental health and counseling.

posted_text:
🧠 PA SB 1505 — PA Schools Ban AI Therapists – Here’s What Changes

Pennsylvania is putting a stop to artificial intelligence from being used for student mental health.

Starting 60 days from now, schools can’t use AI chatbots or other generative AI systems to diagnose, treat, or even recommend treatment for students’ mental health needs.

This means no AI pretending to be a school counselor or psychologist, offering therapy, or suggesting a mental health plan.

The law *does* allow schools to use AI for administrative tasks, like scheduling or record-keeping, as long as it doesn’t mimic a mental health professional.

This change clarifies that AI can’t replace the role of a certified school counselor, social worker, or psychologist – a critical safeguard for student well-being.

Oct. 26, 2026: Referred to Education.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.palegis.us/legislation/bills/2025/sb1505
